found.quote: Assessment misconduct is any action or attempted action that may result in a student obtaining an unfair academic advantage in relation to an assessment.
Relevant factors include whether the tool was used without disclosure, whether it replaced a core academic task (e.g. writing, analysis), and whether its use appears intentional or negligent.
Authorship verification tools (e.g. GPTZero) may be used by the Academic Registrar at this stage for all or some of the assessed material.
If the student does not respond within one month the case will be dealt with in their absence by the Academic Dean.
